commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' A corner kick by St. Pauli is thwarted by the well prepared Tiago Pereira Cardoso (B. Monchengladbach).
90+2' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Christian Dingert blows for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' St. Pauli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
88' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
86' Robin Hack comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
86' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Tim Kleindienst.

85' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Tiago Pereira Cardoso just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.
85' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
83' A substitution has been made. Danel Sinani is replaced by Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli).
82' The statistic for corner kicks – 9:2.
81' The St. Pauli players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
80' The corner is swung in but St. Pauli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' A player from B. Monchengladbach commits a rough challenge. Christian Dingert blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. St. Pauli are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
78' St. Pauli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. St. Pauli win a corner.
76' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) for his blatant foul.
75' The attendance is 29546.

74' The manager makes a subsitution with Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) coming on for Noah Weisshaupt.
74' Alexander Blessin has decided to substitute Elias Saad and he is replaced by Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
64' The corner is swung in but St. Pauli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St. Pauli comes to nothing.

61' That will be all from Lars Ritzka who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli).

58' St. Pauli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

56' The St. Pauli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
52' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
50' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from St. Pauli.
50' St. Pauli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
48' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Christian Dingert had an easy-decision to make.
47' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Tiago Pereira Cardoso was alert and made a comfortable save.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' 0 - 1 The score has changed – 0:1. Franck Honorat sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) jumps highest and plants a header into the top right corner.
45+2' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to send the ball in.
45+1' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

43' Referee Christian Dingert makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
42' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from St. Pauli for a penalty. Play continues.
42' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul. St. Pauli have a free kick from a promising distance.
41' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) sends a cross into the box, but Tiago Pereira Cardoso comes off his line to gather the ball.
40' Neat passing move from B. Monchengladbach in order to create new attacking opportunities.
36' Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
35' One of the St. Pauli players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
34' B. Monchengladbach move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
32' Christian Dingert couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) and blew his whistle.
31' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
30' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
29' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for St. Pauli.
29' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
28' St. Pauli couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Tiago Pereira Cardoso (B. Monchengladbach) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
28' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) was too forceful with his tackle and Christian Dingert interrupted the game to signal a free kick. There is a free kick near the sideline to St. Pauli.

25' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
23' B. Monchengladbach are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.

21' St. Pauli slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
18' St. Pauli are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The linesman signals a throw-in for St. Pauli.
16' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
16' St. Pauli are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
15' Great teamplay by St. Pauli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
12' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
7' St. Pauli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.
